summary: Tested FIX 1 (Manual Trade upgrades): coin search, ticker, MongoDB-backed watchlist, and Binance WebSocket price fallback. Backend 8/9 tests pass; 1 minor expectation mismatch (search endpoint is public, not auth-required). Frontend Manual Trade page loads at route /manual (sidebar link), renders live price via graceful fallback despite Binance being both CORS-blocked (exchangeInfo) and geo-blocked (WebSocket 451) in the preview env. Watchlist add/remove/persist across reload works end-to-end.

minor.issue: Endpoint is publicly accessible (no auth dependency). Review spec said it requires auth. Either add Depends(get_current_user) or update spec. Non-blocking.

integration_issues.issue: Browser is CORS-blocked from Binance exchangeInfo, so the universe falls back to the ~15-coin curated snapshot from /api/market/coins. Searching for coins NOT in the curated list (e.g. PEPE, ARB) returns 0 results in the UI even though the backend /api/market/search supports them. Consider using the backend /api/market/search as the primary source (server has curated fallback + can proxy Binance) instead of calling Binance directly from the browser.

wss://stream.binance.com:9443 returns 451 in preview datacenter. Fallback to coins snapshot works (price renders, no crash), as expected. Live-indicator still shows even though WS never connects; consider reflecting connected/disconnected state visually.

action_items: Decide whether /api/market/search should require auth (add Depends(get_current_user)) or drop the auth claim from spec.
Route mismatch: spec says /manual-trade but the sidebar link + router uses /manual. Direct navigation to /manual-trade redirects to dashboard. Add an alias route or update spec.
Consider driving frontend coin search via GET /api/market/search (server-side, avoids Binance CORS entirely) so users can find non-curated coins like PEPE/ARB in the preview environment.
critical_code_review_comments: market.py get_watchlist: if user document is None, returns [], but ObjectId(user['id']) will raise if id format changes. Safe for now.
add_watchlist: symbol validation uses isalnum() which allows numeric-only symbols; acceptable for tickers.

Frontend fetches Binance exchangeInfo directly from browser and caches in localStorage as fb_universe; this will always fail in most preview/production browsers due to CORS. Better to use backend /api/market/search.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (search of non-curated coins limited by client-side Binance CORS)

seed_data_creation: Temporary registered user TEST_user_<ts>@example.com created for user-scoping test. Admin watchlist entries (PEPE, ZZZTEST, BTC) added and removed as cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend routes verified: /api/market/search, /api/market/ticker, /api/market/watchlist GET/POST/DELETE all functional; watchlist is user-scoped in db.users.watchlist. Frontend Manual Trade route is /manual (not /manual-trade). Binance is fully blocked (CORS + geo 451) from this datacenter/browser; the app gracefully falls back to /api/market/coins snapshot for price and to curated COINS list for search. Live-indicator always renders regardless of WS state.
rca of the issue: Search-for-non-curated-coins issue in browser: root cause is direct client-side call to Binance exchangeInfo which is CORS-blocked. Mitigation: switch frontend to server-side /api/market/search endpoint that already returns proper {symbol,name} results and has its own Binance fallback.
